dogecoin.text: 😑 The crypto top ten printed a red picture on Sunday with #Ethereum (ETH) and its biggest rival #Binance coin (BNB) both falling 1.64% and 0.93%. However, on the bright side Musk’s favorite, #Dogecoin (DOGE) jumped 6.27% and stole #Polkadot (DOT) place in the top 10 leaderboard

😯 In the top 10 cryptos, #Ripple (XRP) led the pack south, with a 3.97% drop in the last 24 hours. #Solana (SOL) also ticked 0.99% lower. On the other hand, the meme coin #Dogecoin (DOGE) staged a spectacular jump of 14.43% as Elon Musk managed to acquire Twitter.

😭 It was a bloodbath in the top 10 spectrum with the meme coin #Dogecoin (DOGE) and #Terra (LUNA) being the main losers dropping by 6.68% and 5.40% respectively. #Cardano (ADA) and #Ripple (XRP) also ticked lower 4.20% and 3.26% lower.

🤫 Meanwhile, the rest top of 10 cryptocurrencies were relatively quiet, as #Avalanche (AVAX) reclaimed its spot kicking #dogecoin (DOGE) back out of the board even with a marginal 0.81% jump. #Solana (SOL) ticked 0.33% higher while #Ripple (XRP) fell 0.74%.

😢 The top 10 cryptocurrencies painted a full red picture with #Solana (SOL) leading the market down tumbling by 25.88% in the last 24 hours. #Dogecoin (DOGE) joined the top 10 cryptocurrencies after the spiral fall of the Terra ecosystem, however, DOGE still edged 22.04% lower.

😢 The top 10 cryptocurrencies by market cap painted a relatively mixed picture with #Cardano (ADA) and #Solana (SOL) ticking 1.22% and 0.46% higher in the last 24 hours. Meanwhile, #Ethereum (ETH) and Elon musk’s favorite coin, #Dogecoin (DOGE) dropped by 2.36% and 2.13%.
